thread:
maria: Heads up — after the kernel-routing tweak landed yesterday I'm seeing intermittent 200–600ms per-token tail spikes on streaming for the chat-route (route=/assistant/chat). Not consistent across traffic but concentrated on long-context sessions :thinking_face:
jeff: ugh, saw a tiny uptick in p50 earlier but not that big. any profiling data yet? :eyes:
sangeet: I pulled a short flamegraph from the perf-runner on two affected pods. looks like kernel selection is bouncing between aten_mm and custom_cuda_fused for attention at long lengths, which is causing extra kernel-launch overheads mid-stream.
anya: do we have a correlation with KV-cache evictions? if the kv cache gets evicted and we switch to a different kernel path we could be paying a penalty mid-generation.
maria: good call. I checked dashboards: dashboard/redwood/runtime/token_latency_breakdown shows an increase in "post-token-kernel-switch" buckets. Also the stream chunk cadence panel shows irregular chunk gaps aligning with the spikes.
perf-bot: perf CI report: https://perf.internal/reports/1768345600/kernel-route-oddities (contains logs + perf artifact)
jeff: ran a targeted repro on staging with --enable-kernel-logging. snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-17T14:12:03Z] kernel_select: chosen=custom_cuda_fused(attn, seq=512)
[2026-03-17T14:12:04Z] kernel_select: fallback=aten_mm(attn, seq=1024)
[2026-03-17T14:12:04Z] kv_cache: evict: user_session=abcd shard=2 reason=mem_pressure
[2026-03-17T14:12:04Z] stream: chunk_emit delay_ms=310
```
jeff: looks like seq length inference goes up after cache evict and we fallback to aten_mm for larger seq which triggers extra launches.
sangeet: hypothesis: our kernel-selection heuristic is using immediate sequence-length heuristics but not aware of imminent KV-hot-path. When kv eviction occurs we recompute planning and pick a safer kernel that has worse per-launch latency for many small chunks.
anya: should we change the heuristic to consider "current kv cache hit rate" or "recent chunk cadence"? maybe prefer a lower-launch-overhead kernel for streaming-heavy routes even if it's slightly lower throughput per-batch.
maria: agree. proposal: add a routing signal to kernel_selector: prefer_low_launch_overhead=true when the route has streaming=true and avg_chunk_time < 50ms. Also emit a metric kernel_switch_cause with tags {route, cause=(kv_eviction|seq_growth|mem_pressure)} so dashboards can filter.
sangeet: I pushed a quick prototype that exposes kernel_switch_cause on /metrics and emits a histogram kernel_switch_latency_ms. putting it behind feature flag kernel_switcher.experimental.
perf-bot: rolled a canary with flag enabled on dedicated canary pool (canary-2). Telemetry: https://dash.internal/runtime/canary-canary-2?k=1768345600
jeff: small repro client -> staging canary shows tail spikes drop by ~70% on route=/assistant/chat but p90 increases slightly for batched non-stream requests. tradeoff expected.
anya: for ops: we should add a per-route KPI on console: streaming_tail_token_latency and kernel_switch_rate. also alert if kernel_switch_rate > 0.5/minute for a single session.
maria: to be safe, patch plan:
  - land metric (kernel_switch_cause)
  - enable feature flag on canary for two hours, gather token-level breakdown and chunk cadence
  - if positive, roll to 10% and monitor per-route KPIs
  - revert if batched throughput regresses >5% or non-stream p95 worsens >3%
jeff: i'll add the canary runbook and a simple script to repro: 
```
# repro script (staging)
python tools/repro_stream.py --route "/assistant/chat" --tokens 1200 --chunk=64 --kv-warmup=1
```
maria: anyone want ownership of dashboard panels? I can add the metric but need someone to wire panels and alerts.
anya: i'll take panel wiring and add alert thresholds. tagging @oncall should we also add a transient alert for stream-stall-count? :bug:
jeff: @oncall FYI — likely noisy but helpful during rollout.
perf-bot: perf job summary: canary kernel_switch_rate down 62%, streaming_tail_token_latency p99 down from 620ms -> 180ms. Non-stream batched throughput p50 down 4%. Artifacts: https://perf.internal/artifacts/1768345600/summary.json
sangeet: next steps: iterate kernel heuristics to include kv hit-rate and chunk cadence smoothing; also look into making fallback path pre-warmed to avoid extra launches.
maria: cool. i'll open a tiny RFC and link this thread. thanks all. :thumbsup:
